casesynthetic_a16.description: Synthetic Android 16 style bug report text (dumpstate.txt) with the network sections: three saved Wi-Fi networks (one marked current, one disabled, one with a comma in the SSID) and a stray entry outside the block, connection events with unpadded times, two mWifiInfo snapshots, scan result tables, state machine records and log blocks, the netstats service and the CHECKIN NETSTATS full dump with a UID table and a bucket at epoch 1000, network policy lists and logs, two connected networks, ip -s link and /proc/net/dev, DNS servers with a private DNS log, netstat with a raw6 line, ss with continuation lines, and a tethering service. Device zone Europe/Paris. Invented values, contains no real evidence.
